details: The `morphing` flag guards against re-entry during the 1200ms morph, but finalization relies on `i === layoutData.length - 1` in the `.on('end')` callback — a fragile pattern since D3 does not guarantee transition end order, meaning `morphing` could reset early and hover opacity mutations on `pointerenter` fire unrestricted during mid-flight transitions with no `.interrupt()` call.
